description: Work to trees covered by LBE ORDER NO 14 (6) 1975: 1 x Sycamore (T1) - crown lift to provide 2.5m clearance between ground level and the lowest remaining foliage, reduction of re-growth arising from previous works, not removing more than 1.0m of growth, 1 x Maple (T3) - crown lift to provide 2.5m clearance between ground level and the lowest remaining foliage, 2 x Maple (G2) - crown lift to provide 4.5m clearance between ground level and the lowest remaining foliage, reduction of re-growth arising from previous works, not removing more than 1.0m of growth, 2 x poplar and 1 x sycamore (G4) - reduction of re-growth arising from previous works, on northern stem only, to provide up to 1.5m clearance from the street lamp and the remaining foliage, not removing more than 2m of growth, 4 x lime and 4 x chestnut (G5) - sympathetic crown thinning of up to 20% of re-growth arising from previous works, to assist in shading concerns., removal of basal and trunk epicormic growth up to 3m height from ground level, and crown lift to provide 3m clearance between ground level and the lowest remaining foliage, 1 x maple (G5a) - crown lift to provide 2.5m clearance between ground level and the lowest remaining foliage, 1 x Sycamore (G7) - Self-set stems - previously pollard, reduction of re-growth arising from previous works, not removing more than 1.0m of growth.
